dog.description_text: Tamara is currently thriving in a foster home with her sister, Tammy. She is a true "big sister" and a natural-born leader. Tamara is endlessly curious and loves nothing more than exploring every nook and cranny of her surroundings. She has a spirited, confident personality and is best known for her adorable, signature head shakes that are sure to melt your heart. If you are looking for a brave, adventurous companion to lead the way in your home, Tamara is ready to step into that role! Apply for her today.
dog.name: Tamara
